input.sql: select FLX_ANN_MOI, count(*), sum(PRS_REM_MNT) from FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS group by 1 order by 1

input.final_sql:
select r.BEN_RES_REG_LIB, sum(f.PRS_REM_MNT) as amount
from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f
join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION r on f.BEN_RES_REG = r.BEN_RES_REG
where f.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501 and r.BEN_RES_REG <> 99
group by 1
order by 2 desc
limit 3
